# FLX-3614: consumers limits.seconds is above the engine's ceiling

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A bundle may only lower the wall clock a query may take: limits.seconds is at most 30, the engine's ceiling, and a bundle that asks for more is refused by every command. The command-line flag --max-query-seconds raises the ceiling to at most 600 for the command that runs the queries, for a bundle that declares no limits.seconds of its own.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3614
```
